'''Yatooni Boska''' was a beverage served by [[Chef/Legends|chefs]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In the ''[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide]]'' [[Ebenn Q3 Baobab/Legends|Ebenn Q3 Baobab]] authored in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] scholar recommended that readers of his [[Book/Legends|book]] try the drink while visiting any Huttese [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurants]] in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He described the drink as mind-relaxing and listed it amongst his favorite Huttese [[Foodstuff/Legends|foods]] and drinks in the [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] [[Language/Legends|language]] section of his guide.<ref name="GPBATG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yatooni Boska was first mentioned in the [[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']], which was written by [[Ben Burtt]] in [[2001]].<ref name="GPBATG" />
